title: Absolut Halloween
summary: An illustrated jack-o'-lantern-skull character design applied as a Halloween-themed campaign across Absolut Vodka bottle packaging, a billboard, phone-screen ads, a poster on a brick wall, a repeat pattern, and a skateboard deck, with accompanying process shots of the artwork being sketched on an iPad.

title: Physio Action
summary: A full rebrand and campaign system for Physio Action, a physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic group with locations across West Yorkshire (Ilkley, Leeds, Harrogate, Guiseley). The set shows a new wordmark and soundwave/heartbeat icon replacing an older bar-chart logo, applied across business cards, a hoodie/t-shirt/backpack apparel line, bottle packaging, campaign posters ("Move.", "Work it.", "Feel free."), Instagram post/story templates, and a website mockup on a laptop.

title: In Lamentation
summary: Brand identity and website design for "In Lamentation," a restaurant by Chef Michael O'Hare (Boston Spa, Yorkshire, opening date shown as 02.26), built around a distinctive overlapping black wordmark and black-glove/rock photography. Shown via storefront, street-poster and subway OOH mockups plus laptop and phone mockups of the site's homepage (hero, reservations, contact/booking sections).

title: Sika
summary: Dramatically lit, heavily retouched advertising photography for Sika (construction/building materials) showing five different tradespeople (builder, joiner, landscaper, plasterer, roofer) individually and as a group, styled with tools and workwear against composited dusk skies on UK residential streets.

title: Ces Enfants
summary: A cohesive packaging and identity system for a fragrance brand called Ces Enfants (product labelled "Extroverted Introvert" Extrait de Parfum), built in a blue, silver and black palette across boxes, tester bottles, blister packs, sample vials and an industrial ratchet-strap closure, supported by technical spec sheets, an OOH poster mockup and editorial/campaign photography.

title: Hayton
summary: Brand identity and website design for Hayton, an AI-focused executive search consultancy (tagline "The Source of Competitive Advantage," run by Jamie Hayton at hayton.ai). The set covers a serif wordmark with an animal-head mark, a black/olive/cream colour and type system, business stationery, a brochure/book box, exterior building signage, and a multi-page marketing website (home, "The Game," Executive Search, Brand Reinvention, Contact) shown in laptop and tablet mockups.

title: Baijiu Society
summary: Brand identity, packaging and advertising work for a baijiu (Chinese spirit) brand called Baijiu Society: a black bottle wrapped in a black snake with gold Chinese calligraphy and a "BAIJIUSOCIETY / The Spirit of Society" wordmark, a separate gold "Society" script logotype shot over a model's face, neon shop-signage and street-billboard mockups, and a set of surreal photo-composite key visuals and posters (Society, Love, Prosperity, Defining a Dynasty, Forever United, Culture Embodied) built around a recurring pink anatomical-heart and neon-type motif.

title: Annabelles
summary: A single cinematic photo shoot: one model in 18th-century-style corseted gowns and powdered wig, shot in a candlelit boudoir set with ornate mirrors, floral wallpaper, and floral arrangements. Styling, lighting, and set design are polished and dramatic, but the folder contains only photography — no visible logo, type, or other graphic design artefacts.

title: Apollo Financial
summary: A complete brand identity system for Apollo Financial, a UK financial consultancy: triangular icon mark, "apollo" lowercase wordmark in Akkurat Light Pro, a dark-purple/lilac/grey-green colour palette, and the strapline "Experience & expertise come together," applied across letterhead and business cards, a branded presentation box and book, a website mockup, grayscale team photography, and an architectural glass-manifestation treatment of the wordmark.

title: Berry's
summary: A jewellery brand identity and advertising campaign for "Berry's" ("Yours Truly Since 1897"), shown through OOH mockups (subway posters/lightboxes, a street billboard), a magazine cover/print piece, two website/laptop mockups, and flat key-art for three named product lines (Verve, Ember, Opeia) built around close-up ring/jewellery and portrait photography with an elegant script logotype.

title: Burgo
summary: A speculative brand identity and campaign for "Burgo," a fictional luxury self-promotion/packaging company: a custom brush-script logotype, black-and-white apparel and stationery mockups, orange-and-black product packaging ("Just Pull It"), and campaign posters that superimpose the concept onto real Nike, Prada, and Tom Ford products with an on-slide disclaimer that it is not affiliated with those brands.

title: By Bryony
summary: A brand identity presentation deck for "By Bryony™," a London-based "unapologetically healthy" food brand aimed at women, covering logo lockup, colour palette, typography, cooking-oil packaging, a sticker pack, poster/billboard ad mockups, a website mockup, and staged food and editorial photography.

title: Cedarwell
summary: A brand identity and packaging case study for Cedarwell, a bespoke woodworking/joinery brand with the tagline "Craft Without Compromise." Shown work includes a logo wordmark and CW monogram variants, packaging and product photography for a limited-edition carved wood block piece, business cards, a hoodie merch mockup, a website/laptop mockup, and furniture (stool) render slides, presented across cream and black typographic case-study pages.

title: Chelsea Truck Co
summary: Product and lifestyle photography for Chelsea Truck Co (a Kahn Design-built, customised Jeep Wrangler line, "Hand Built by Kahn... LNDN SW10" per the spare-wheel cover), covering two vehicle builds — a matte olive model and a grey model with orange interior. Shots include full-vehicle exterior and aerial views, macro detail of the CHELSEA-branded grille, fuel cap and spare-wheel cover, and close-ups of interior leather trim in red, grey, orange and tan.

title: Citrus
summary: A full brand identity system for Citrus, a construction/property management company (stationery references "Kent" and copy mentions developments in Birmingham and Newcastle), built around the line "Collaboration & Control" and "More than management." The deck covers logo/wordmark construction, a square-C icon mark, a black-and-burnt-orange sunset-gradient palette with a technical monospace typeface, packaging (branded box and internal folder holding a "More Than Management" booklet), a poster/print triptych, apparel (branded sweatshirt), and a website mockup shown both on a laptop and as a flat screen.

title: Colenso
summary: Full brand identity for Colenso, a York-based UK commercial property consultancy (colensoproperty.com), covering the "colenso™" logotype and its construction grid, a four-colour system (Shadow Black, Pure White, Soft Kahki, Olive) paired with architectural shadow photography, business stationery, a website/app UI concept shown on tablet and phone, out-of-home window signage and print ads, an Apple Watch app icon, and a small branded apparel range (t-shirts and hoodies).

title: Crabbies
summary: A single high-resolution composited advertising image showing an amateur cyclist finishing a race amid confetti and a cheering, flag-waving crowd, alongside two medal-wearing Team GB cyclists, with British Cycling branded finish-line tape — evidently retouching/compositing work for a cycling-tied campaign, though no product or Crabbie's branding is visible in the frame itself.

title: Ecrin
summary: A cohesive fashion/jewelry campaign photoshoot: several models in cream, tan and gold leather corsets, satin trench coats and cream blazers, styled with fine gold necklaces, bracelets and rings, photographed against a sunlit cream breeze-block wall with mid-century wooden sideboards as props.

title: Hisense
summary: CGI-style advertising visuals for Hisense televisions, each showing the on-screen content (a film car-chase scene, a video-game character, and Formula One racing) breaking out of the TV screen into the room, with a person seated in an armchair watching.

title: Momentum
summary: A brand identity and campaign built around "Momentum Instore" (sub-lines "Instore™, Insite™, Afterlife™"), shown entirely through mockups: a boxed press/media kit and editorial magazine spread, business cards and folders, a "Power Pack" mailer box with purple inner sleeve, a printed t-shirt, a subway/OOH poster panel, and two website homepage renders on laptop screens.

title: OLTO
summary: A brand identity system for OLTO, a health-and-fitness-club brand ("Health & Fitness Club", "Club Olto"), shown across logo/wordmark lockups and grid explorations, a water bottle, a canvas tote bag and a kraft paper bag, campaign photography of models in OLTO-branded streetwear, a full-bleed poster announcing an event ("Comes to Leeds, 26.02.26"), and laptop mockups of an "OLTO Fitness Club" website.

title: Propaganda
summary: A series of seven 3D-rendered objects - an oil drum, a house, a steel I-beam, a laptop, a magnifying glass, a microphone, and an armchair - each shown melting/dripping in liquid gold and suspended by a gold thread against a plain cream backdrop.

title: Reward
summary: Five CGI advertising key visuals, each pairing a photographed worker from a different trade (chef, mover, runner, forklift operative, painter/decorator) with a large swirling multicolour ribbon graphic rendered above them against a pastel gradient background.

title: Pizza Sluts
summary: Brand identity and guerrilla poster campaign for "Pizza Sluts" (trademarked in-image as "The Slutty Pizza Co. Ltd"), based in Leeds (phone 01132 456871, "15 Eldon Terrace"): a pizza-slice icon mark, multiple bold wordmark/type lockups, a 10-up business card type exploration, circular badge marks, and a series of outdoor poster mockups on textured walls. The poster series pairs the "PIZZASLUTS" wordmark with food-as-innuendo photography that escalates into explicit nude imagery later in the set, with a small pizza-slice graphic used as a partial censor sticker.

title: The Curse at Alton Manor
summary: Key art and campaign visuals for a Halloween haunted-attraction concept called "The Curse at Alton Manor" — a ghostly Victorian-doll/girl character composited into fog, an outdoor poster-in-situ mockup on a shopfront lightbox, and two CGI/composite scenes of a costumed figure standing in an ornate haunted corridor with checkerboard flooring and a chandelier.

title: Volt
summary: Two photographic composites where a large glowing orange/yellow orb of light has been digitally added into real home-interior lifestyle photos - one of two adults in a kitchen/living room, one of a girl playing a games console in her bedroom. Appears to be retouching/compositing work for an advertising campaign, likely for a light, heat or energy-related product called Volt.
